$$
A=\begin{bmatrix}-3 & 2 & -1 \\ 1 & 2 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & 2\end{bmatrix},\,B=\begin{bmatrix}-3 & 0 & -5 \\ 1 & 0 & -3 \\ 0 & 1 & 2\end{bmatrix}
$$

By applying elementary row operations of the form $R_{i}:=R_{i}+kR_{3},$ the matrix $A$ can be transformed into the matrix $B.$ What are the elementary row operations?

$$
\begin{bmatrix}-3 & 2 & -1 \\ 1 & 2 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & 2\end{bmatrix}
\xrightarrow{R_{1}:=R_{1}-2R_{3}}\begin{bmatrix}-3 & 0 & -5 \\ 1 & 2 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & 2\end{bmatrix}
\xrightarrow{R_{2}:=R_{2}-2R_{3}}\begin{bmatrix}-3 & 0 & -5 \\ 1 & 0 & -3 \\ 0 & 1 & 2\end{bmatrix}=B
$$

Therefore, the elementary row operations are

$R_{1}:=R_{1}-2R_{3}$ and $R_{2}:=R_{2}-2R_{3}$.
